rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive construction for something located in the middle or in between.

example.english: Someone’s already sitting in the middle seat.
example.jyutping: zung1 gaan1 ge3 wai2 jau5 jan4 zo6 zo2 laa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the part or point between two ends, including a middle point in time.

example.english: I'm in the middle of the movie, and I need to go to the toilet.
example.traditional: 套戲睇到中間，我要去廁所。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 tai2 dou3 zung1 gaan1 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 ci3 so2

rows.note: Use this for the central point of a circle, place, or other object rather than a section between two ends.

example.english: There's a red dot in the middle of this circle.
example.traditional: 呢個圓形嘅中心有粒紅點。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyun4 jing4 ge3 zung1 sam1 jau5 nap1 hung4 dim2

rows.note: Use this for the waist or central part of a person's body.

example.english: My middle has been aching all day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 jiu1 tung3 zo2 seng4 jat6

rows.note: Use this for a person or group occupying the political center of the spectrum.

example.english: We're not left- or right-wing; we're the middle faction.
example.traditional: 我哋唔係左派或者右派，係中間派。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 hai6 zo2 paai3 waak6 ze2 jau6 paai3 hai6 zung1 gaan1 paai3
